text_block_list.text:
One day, as we pass through the
shopping district
on the way home...

Huh, they're doing something over
there.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: A hot spring vacation, huh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Are you a fan of hot springs?

text_block_list.text:
I guess I could say so? When I finish a
big job, my
manager always takes me to
one as a reward.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: But I've never been to one on my own.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I remember I had received a
raffle
ticket the last time I shopped over
here.
...Sure, why not?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Can I do the spinning?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити gives the raffle machine a
gentle spin!

A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
Oooh!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Whoa, we actually won!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I'm shocked. That was way too easy...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Does this mean I'm...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Maybe the gods did you a service for
your
striking beauty, young lady!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: You know what, I don't need this.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: D-did I say something wrong?!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
I'm always like this. Mother always
scolded me for
making such unnecessary
comments. Oh, I've
offended her!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
After calming down the raffle clerk, I
hurriedly
chase after Голд Сити with the
vacation ticket in
hand.
Did I upset the guy from the raffle?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Uh-huh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I know he didn't mean any offense.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: And after I won using your ticket, too. Shoulda just kept the coupon, but oh well.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: It's all right! He gave it to me!

text_block_list.text: Seriously? In that situation?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Dang, you don't miss a trick, do you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: But I think you won this ticket yourself.

text_block_list.text:
I... I'm good. Can't take it now after what
I did
back there.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: You use it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I probably wouldn't even enjoy it if I
went.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: So... congrats. Bye now.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
Wow, it's massive.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But it looks delicious... And the glazed
carrot is so
shiny.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Too good, in fact. Bet my manager
would be
pissed if I ate it all.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You don't think you'll be able to balance it out?

text_block_list.text: Excuse me?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Who do you think you're talking to? I'm
a
professional at maintaining my figure.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: It'll be fine. So... I guess I'll dig in.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I'll eat all this and stay in shape. Just you watch.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>

Huh, a bushel. That's actually really
helpful.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Carrots are supposed to be good for
your skin.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And above all, they're delicious. So it's a
plus to
have a bunch to keep for later.
I'll leave them
with my manager.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Actually... there's something I've been
wondering
about—you guys aren't such
huge fans of carrots,
are you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Well, some people like them plenty.

text_block_list.text: But you wouldn't fight over them or anything, would you? Meanwhile at the Tracen cafeteria, it's harder to find a dish that doesn't have carrots in it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm sure there must be some students who don't like them, but I know I never met one.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And, you know, I talked about carrots in
a
magazine column before, and all the
reactions I
got were from Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I remember it struck me as weird. Carrots
are
delicious, so... why's it just us?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I talked about this with my manager
before, and
then she started carrying
carrot sticks with her
everywhere.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I'm not complaining, but it's not like I'm that in love with them. For instance, last week...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>

What am I supposed to do with one
carrot?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
Seems like more than enough for preparing a
meal.

text_block_list.text:
You're talking to an Umamusume. One is
far from
enough.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
Well, I was thinking you'd also use other
ingredients...

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's what you mean? ...I mean, I
knew that.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Cooking, huh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: What? Like that's any of your business?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Just out of curiosity, though... If you
were me,
what would you make with this
carrot?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
Lame. And I'm supposed to be a model.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I get one chance and pull a pack of
tissues. What
a joke.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And that's how I end up holding onto
the ticket
for the hot spring vacation.

Leaving behind the topic of carrots,
Gold City
continues sharing anecdotes
about her manager
as we make our way
back to the academy.

This is more than lame. This is, like,
humiliating.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And so, I teach Голд Сити some recipes
as we
make our way back to the
academy.

Голд Сити chows down on her
lip-smacking
hamburger steak and
nonetheless manages to
keep in shape
afterward—of course.
